This is the start of property-level Uppie utility, not the end of it. Later releases add Uppies appearing and moving in 3D on the map, Uppie employment at eligible structures, and automated Trove collection. Level 5 and higher Uppies will automatically collect Troves from plants in a later release, with higher-level Uppies collecting more each day. Where you assign them will matter. And Troves, Banking, and Progression are confirmed before Harvest Season begins on October 1, 2026

Collect Troves through gameplay from plants, structures, and recipes. Bank them permanently into your Trove Vault and climb Banking levels. Progress through a new Upland Progression level by banking Troves, developing your portfolio, and completing objectives.

[Crypto has 50% of the scam market](https://consumerfed.org/news/press-releases/americans-lost-an-estimated-148-billion-to-online-scams-crimes-in-2025-up-nearly-26-from-2024-1009-per-household-average/)

The Consumer Federation of America (CFA) estimates that Americans lost $148 billion to online scams and crime in 2025, up 26% from 2024. More than half of the losses — $80.7 billion — are thought to have involved cryptocurrency.

The CFA gets to those numbers by using a multiplier based on the DOJ’s estimate that only 14% of financial crimes are typically reported. $20.8 billion of losses were reported to law enforcement in 2025. 7.1x that number is $148 billion. 

“This is the conservative choice,” the report says. “Some studies report rates as low as 4-5%, implying multipliers of 20-25x.”

Using a 25x multiplier would put total losses at roughly $520 billion. Yikes.

==“This crisis demands additional bold action through legislation, enforcement, and public education at every level,” the report concludes.==

==It also hints at a preventative measure we can take right now: Stop using Facebook. Facebook is the venue for an ==[estimated](https://bbbmarketplacetrust.org/riskreport2024/)== 57% of all online scams.==

==That might just be because Facebook is where we spend most of our scrolling time. But a ====_Wall Street Journal_==== ==[report](https://www.wsj.com/tech/meta-fraud-facebook-instagram-813363c8)== puts at least some of the blame on lax oversight: Facebook allows suspicious advertisers to rack up as many as 32 automated “strikes” for financial fraud before it bans their accounts.==

==_32 strikes and you’re out!_==

==A final statistic suggests next year’s report could be even uglier. The CFA’s new category of AI-enabled fraud accounted for $6.3 billion in losses.==

76730.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These were the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto today:

* **[Uniswap](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/uniswap-protocol-revenue-nearly-triples-after-v4-fee-switch-as-uni-tops-usd4)**[ protocol revenue nearly triples after the v4 fee switch](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/uniswap-protocol-revenue-nearly-triples-after-v4-fee-switch-as-uni-tops-usd4)

* **[ENS](https://thedefiant.io/news/nfts-and-web3/ens-scales-back-plan-to-move-dao-treasury-control-to-new-foundation)**[ drops the plan to move its treasury wallet to a foundation](https://thedefiant.io/news/nfts-and-web3/ens-scales-back-plan-to-move-dao-treasury-control-to-new-foundation)

* **[Aave](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-moves-to-retire-50-low-adoption-assets-wind-down-six-chains)**[ moves to retire 50 assets and wind down six chains](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-moves-to-retire-50-low-adoption-assets-wind-down-six-chains)

* **[Ready](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/ready-shuts-card-program-after-issuer-winds-down)**['s card program dies with its issuer Kulipa](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/ready-shuts-card-program-after-issuer-winds-down)

Uniswap turned the fee switch on for its newest pools this week. The money showed up. So did the fight.

Protocol revenue has nearly tripled since the July 27 activation, with [about $325,000 flowing toward UNI burns in the past 24 hours](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/uniswap-protocol-revenue-nearly-triples-after-v4-fee-switch-as-uni-tops-usd4) against a run rate near $114,000 a day earlier in July, according to DefiLlama. UNI rallied 12% over 24 hours to about $4.40. Robinhood Chain alone supplied $170,353 of that daily total, more than half of it, with Ethereum mainnet adding $81,866.

The argument is about who pays for it. Alexander Cutler, co-founder of Aerodrome developer Dromos Labs, told anyone holding locked v2 or v3 liquidity their fee share had been cut by up to 25%. Uniswap co-founder **Hayden Adams** called that math "made-up": in v4 the protocol fee lands on the trader, on top of the LP's full rate. They’re both describing real mechanics in different versions of the protocol, and Uniswap's own documentation backs each of them. Three days in, traders are still paying and roughly $3 billion in total value locked has stayed put.

**Read more below!**
